rules.condition: posting does not state a language requirement
local language is preferred/desirable but not mandatory
local language is mandatory and candidate proficiency is not confirmed
German C1 or C2 is explicitly mandatory for teaching
native/bilingual local language is explicitly mandatory and profile does not establish it
English is the working language or academic English is required

country_notes.DE: Teaching-heavy roles with explicit German C1/C2 are strong blockers under the current profile policy.
country_notes.FR: French faculty is already out of scope; French-language requirements on postdoctoral/research roles remain reviewable unless a deterministic mismatch is established.
country_notes.NL: Dutch requirements are not inferred from country; evaluate only explicit posting language.
country_notes.BE: Dutch/French requirements are not inferred from country; evaluate only explicit posting language.
country_notes.AT: German requirements are not inferred from country; evaluate only explicit posting language.
